flaws.B: Only the sword arm moves on a static, blurry body, so the strike looks pasted on and the softer rendering pops against frame 0.
flaws.D: The sword never leaves the ready grip, so no strike reads at all.
flaws.F: Frame 1 pops taller and its sword tip is cropped by the frame edge, which mars an otherwise excellent, punchy swing.
flaws.H: Clean and consistent but a little reserved: the anticipation lean and the shield's balance swing are small.
flaws.K: A purple halo outline and the shield flipping to its fist side in frames 4-5 hurt consistency in the most dynamic swing.
flaws.M: Solid but generic, with magenta stray pixels and fringe (frame 3 feet) and a stiff, upright smear frame.
flaws.P: Magenta halo outlines and a washed-out palette in frames 6-7 make the recovery pop away from the reference.
flaws.S: A tan smudge on the shorts in frames 3-6 and a blurry frame 7 break consistency.

strike.notes: Ordering was easy for every letter except D, whose poses differ only by small sword tilts and stance shuffles. In several letters the recover and settle frames (6/7) are near-identical. F, K, H, M, P and S all read as a strike at 1x; F and K have the strongest lunges.
